supplementalReferences.name: mitm-dev
supplementalReferences.scope: Request and MITM certificate design only; maintained independently of the overall UI, Android and sing-box baselines. Local paths are relative to the repository root.

files.changes: GPL-3.0 license included in exported CA modules.
Unmodified installer entry, moved to its ZIP path.
Unmodified installer marker, moved to its ZIP path.

Reference for system/Conscrypt APEX and init/zygote/app mount namespaces. B-box patches Zygotes before discovering all visible mount namespaces, deduplicates each scan by namespace identity, rechecks actual stores on every pass, pins namespace/root/interpreter/script/public-CA descriptors before nsenter, stages complete per-store tmpfs copies in /dev, retains hash collisions, and returns pending/failure results. No live stale-certificate removal.
Uses the B-box injector's non-waiting --early pass and resets this boot's diagnostic log; readiness retries belong to service.sh.

Runs one flock-protected reconciliation loop, retries boot readiness every two seconds for at most 60 fast passes, then checks late/recreated namespaces and replaced stores every 30 seconds until disabled/removed. Records the latest exit status and bounded changed-result logs.

Reference for Android CA identity, hash names, store/namespace limitations and public module export. B-box implements non-exportable Keystore signing, revision checks and AtomicFile persistence; no automatic root command or private-key export.
Distinguish user/system trust and refresh after returning from settings. B-box queries its local Android bridge and isolates remote sessions.

Reference for explicit CA operations and certificate setup. B-box uses independent profile MITM with an ordered allowlist (empty decrypts nothing), exclusions and optional TLS/TCP streams. Decryption controls and one certificate entry share the MITM page; certificate access does not require a loaded profile. JSON editing covers additional ports/packages settings. HTTP rewriting and HTTP/cron scripts are separate B-box extensions. Certificate rotation is blocked during capture or active MITM. Shared form/navigation components are reused; no Mihomo configuration.

Reference for HTTP exchange information. B-box keeps bounded libbox request and TLS/TCP stream records with independent exchange IDs and an optional original sing-box connection UUID. Connections remains a separate page. Requests shows recording controls without a profile-rewrite banner or dedicated capture logs.

Reference for per-message navigation. B-box uses its record menu and copyable rows with route/TLS metadata and trailers; raw TLS/TCP streams have two body directions without HTTP header/cookie menus or cURL export.
FEATURE_MITM is disabled by default in this reference. The public FlClash core is not used as an MITM backend.
